name: Can I still file a claim if I was partially at fault for the 18-wheeler accident?

mainEntity.name: Can I still file a claim if I was partially at fault for the 18-wheeler accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even if you were partially at fault for an 18-wheeler accident, you can still file a claim in California. California operates under a 'pure comparative negligence' rule. This means that your compensation may be reduced by your percentage of fault. For example, if you are found 20% at fault, your total awarded damages would be reduced by 20%. An attorney can help determine fault, gather evidence to minimize your responsibility, and ensure you receive the maximum possible compensation under this rule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, in California's 'pure comparative negligence' system, you can file a claim even if partially at fault, though your compensation may be reduced by your fault percentage.
